security_problem: A stolen minted JWT or a burned STS/workload key is an incident. If trace skips hash-chain verification, an attacker who tampers with audit JSONL can hide or rewrite hops. If trace only accepts txn, an operator holding the compact JWT cannot find the actor chain from its jti.
required_behavior: Opening an STS or visor-gateway audit JSONL verifies prev_hash, chain_index, and payload hash from genesis. trace -txn reconstructs that transaction. trace -jti returns every record for the transaction that minted that jti. A broken chain fails closed. Key-compromise procedures are documented in docs/runbooks.md. This is not Production.
failure_behavior: Fail closed: incomplete audit records, hash mismatch, prev_hash or chain_index breaks, and missing txn/jti produce a process or CLI error and no reconstructed hops from a tampered STS log.
